Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: While Shy did have some good art, I thought lot of his vampire portraits looked rather bland, and in some cases, he used the exact same picture for several portraits with just changing the colors some.

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
Yeah, too many very similar looking vampires wasn't that good a thing. Not bad art but just too much of the same thing.

I do suspect that he was commissioned on the last minute to do a BIG pile of cards (probably to fill for someone who didn't make it to the deadline) which would explain why the cards are so similar.

Thats a problem with alot of gangrel, though. I dont just mean his art, either, since una is decently animal looking. Some gangrel should be pretty ish, but id expect more Basilia for ferals and Hartmut stover for titled ones. Tidy gangrel are wierd. Nossies can in theory obfuscate themselves to a level of ugly that puts others off and boosts thier own self image, so theres room there, imo.

Shy has some great vamp art when i think on it, and some stuff that blends with itself is the opposite end of the spectrum with his stuff. Thematically appropriate always, but take Matthias: presumably a lonwr(matthias of Baath is in no books i own, who nows...) as a salubri in modern times, looks kinda unkept but still together. Muse is decnt, despite doc having less artistic cohesion than salubri in bl. Then you get several Lasombra looking like one another, and thats the least good stuff from him, again, imo.

But really, we could, mayne should, spend a thread in artistic direction of crypt cards. Its kinda late, tho, since the indy set is possibly already getting work in.....

We have 16 pieces for the set finished already, with 4 more being worked on. Another 7 or so cards were submitted to the Art Director for artwork as a result of Round One playtest feedback. Still plenty more artwork needed, so comments and suggestions - and artists! - are most certainly welcome.
